name: mri_breast
description: Order a breast MRI for high-risk screening, cancer staging, implant evaluation, or problem-solving when mammography and ultrasound are inconclusive.

contrast.description: Breast MRI requires IV gadolinium for dynamic contrast enhancement

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., BRCA carrier, newly diagnosed breast cancer staging)

when_to_use: high-risk breast cancer screening (BRCA1/2, >20% lifetime risk)
staging of newly diagnosed breast cancer (extent of disease)
evaluation of breast implant integrity (silicone implant rupture)
problem-solving when mammography and ultrasound are inconclusive

examples.query: BRCA1-positive patient, age 32, needs breast cancer screening

args.clinical_indication: high-risk breast cancer screening, BRCA1 carrier
